note: Attic 'times of life' room under the roof (the rarest abstract time nouns). Nine feminine words, so the divider is offset to x=840: feminine on the left and centre (l'issue, la préface, la pension, l'ère, la destinée, l'initiation, la décennie, l'immortalité, l'introduction); masculine on the right (le commencement, le retraité, le prolongement, le renouvellement). The wooden door on the far left goes back to the attic adverbs room (dead-end room; the way back is that door).
